reuse.why: Routes every server and preview site through the existing exported getScheduledAmount, which already decided the missing/number/range cases.

duplication.why: Removes five inline copies of the null/number/midpoint dispatch; the rule now exists once.

placement.why: The rule change is made in shared/schedules.ts, the module that already owns the expected schedule amount used by client and server.

scope.why: Limited to the amount helper, its call sites, a type widening for null and tests.

maintainability.why: Any future change to how a schedule's expected amount is derived is a one-function edit.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, now called by schedule-template, forecast-schedules, schedules/app (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), the preview and the client components
